description: This file defines a utility module for initializing and providing a singleton instance of the Supabase client, primarily for use in a React frontend environment. It manages the creation of the client using environment variables, ensures only one instance exists, and provides a method to access this client.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient()
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the Supabase client, creating it if it does not already exist. Uses environment variables for configuration and warns if they are missing.
